title: Mobile Fitting Unit Service Schedule for SafeStep Customers
content:
# Mobile Fitting Unit — Service Schedule

Corbett's mobile shoe and eyewear fitting unit visits the customer's site under the SafeStep Safety Footwear & Eyewear Program on the terms below. Fees are in US dollars and are charged to the employer.

| Tier | Mobile visits to the customer's site included per year | Fee per mobile visit beyond the included visits | Participants who must redeem at a visit to avoid the low attendance fee | Low attendance fee for a visit below that minimum | Calendar days of notice needed to book a visit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SafeStep Voucher Basic | 0 | 450.00 | 25 | 200.00 | 21 |
| SafeStep Voucher Plus | 0 | 450.00 | 25 | 200.00 | 21 |
| SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear | 0 | 400.00 | 25 | 175.00 | 21 |
| SafeStep Mobile Fitting | 4 | 350.00 | 20 | 150.00 | 14 |
| SafeStep Premier | 6 | 300.00 | 15 | 100.00 | 14 |
| SafeStep Enterprise | 12 | 0.00 | 10 | 0.00 | 7 |

## Service conditions

- **Included visits.** On SafeStep Voucher Basic, SafeStep Voucher Plus and SafeStep Footwear & Eyewear no visit is included; every visit on those tiers is beyond the included visits.
- **Attendance minimum.** The minimum is a count of participants who redeem at the visit.
- **Zero amounts.** On SafeStep Enterprise both the visit fee and the low attendance fee are 0.00.
- **Notice.** The notice figure is in calendar days.

## Service points by tier

- SafeStep Premier includes six visits a year; SafeStep Enterprise includes twelve.
- On SafeStep Mobile Fitting, 20 participants must redeem at a visit to avoid the low attendance fee.
- A SafeStep Enterprise customer books a visit with 7 calendar days of notice; the three lowest tiers need 21.
